cause.code_defect: Each center callback replaced previous progress with the immediately preceding callback, even if that callback represented the identical progress. Repeated SwiftUI modifier evaluations can therefore overwrite a directional observation with equality before the screenshot poll reads it.
cause.runtime_limit: The failed log records the missing directional snapshot, not a complete per-callback trace; duplicate evaluations are a code-level reproduction of this sampling defect, not independently proven as the only possible cause on that runner.

fix: Track distinct rendered values in a fixture-only helper. Identical style/progress callbacks leave sequence and previous distinct progress unchanged. A new progress records the old distinct value; style changes reset direction. Use this exact helper in the UI sampler and mandatory Apple model regression.
regression: Exercise repeated callbacks during entry and exit, sequence stability, reversal, and style-change reset. Worker requires the regression success marker before continuing. Keep directional 0.4...0.6 snapshot selection and every rendered-pixel/motion threshold unchanged.
